plugins.description: Your personal context engine. Gives Claude Code read-only access to your local LokalBot meeting library on macOS, Windows, or Linux (alpha) via the /lokalbot:recall command, the lokalbot-cli skill, and a stdio MCP server, and /lokalbot:setup to install and set up LokalBot on a Mac with your approval.
